_about: Creature friends. help: what the friend does in a battle (type shield: blocks the health loss of mistakes; type heart: more hearts in each battle). The player never loses a friend.
_nameAbout: gloss: the glossary id of the name of the friend. The player can choose another name. The texts use the chosen name in place of the glossary name.
_rideAbout: ride: optional, for later eras. A friend with a ride block can carry the hero on the map. speed: a factor for the walk speed. over: the kinds of tiles that the friend can cross. Era 1 does not use it yet.
